threads.name: The Rockefeller Legacy in Art Donation
threads.description: This theme explores how Nelson A. Rockefeller's donation of his collection influenced the Met's exhibitions and renovations. It begins with his donation in 1969, turns with the establishment and opening of the Michael C. Rockefeller Wing in 1982, and pays off with the ongoing renovations of the wing in 2021.

threads.name: The Evolution of The Met's Collection
threads.description: This theme traces the growth and transformation of The Met's collection over time. It starts with the founding of The Met in 1870, turns with the expansion to over two million works by 2000, and culminates with the renovation efforts in 2021.

threads.name: Cultural Representation at The Met
threads.description: This theme examines how The Met represents diverse cultures through its exhibitions. It begins with the dedication to exhibiting arts from Africa, Oceania, and the Americas, turns with the separation of exhibitions by geographical locations, and pays off with the renovation of the Michael C. Rockefeller Wing.
